japanese: 俺は英雄にはなれないのか
english: Can't I ever become a hero...?

japanese: お前が言ってどうする

english: You think that's the end of it?!
I'll pierce you with a blade of wind!
Take flight, blade of the blue sky!
You gave us a lot of trouble.
This is the power of a hero!
Let's finish this in one go!
Looks like that's its weak spot.

japanese: 一人で回復してもしょうがないんだけど
english: Healing only myself won't help much...

japanese: フィアンフルストーム!
氷結は終焉、せめて刹那にて砕けよ！
english: Ice is your end. Shatter in a single instant!

japanese: 大地に秘められし、破壊の力よ！
english: O power of destruction sealed within the earth!

japanese: 古より伝わりし浄化の炎、落ちよ！
english: Purifying flame of ancient lore, fall!

japanese: 恐怖と共に消えよ！薙げ！極限の嵐！
english: Vanish with your fear! Sweep them away, ultimate storm!

japanese: 我が呼びかけに答えよ！
荘厳なる意志は今ここに！
english: A majestic will, here and now!

japanese: 来たれ！大地のきらめき！
english: Come forth, radiance of the earth!

japanese: 静かなる意志、粛清の力に変えて！
english: Turn this quiet will into the power to purge!
Hearts of justice, be with us!

japanese: 舞い降りし疾風の巫女よ！

english: I won't let you have your way!
We did it, we did it!
We just can't lose, you know!

japanese: ふぅ、私を怒らせないで！
ああ、なんか納得いかねえ
english: Ugh, something about this doesn't sit right.
Didn't make it in time, huh...

japanese: 我ながら素晴らしい連携だ！
english: Even I have to admit, that was great teamwork!
Don't come over here right now!
Off to the afterlife with you!

japanese: クリティカルブレード!
スパイラルドライバー!
ファイナルプレイヤー!
神天烈空残光旋風滅災神罰滑殺撃!
神天烈空残光旋風滅災神罰
プリズムフラッシャー!

english: Alright, on to the next one.

japanese: これが勝利の神髄だぜ！
俺の進化は止まらんぜ！

english: Shut up and follow my lead.
Is that the only trick you know?

japanese: その攻撃はガードしきれん！かわせ！
english: You can't block that attack! Dodge it!

japanese: フンジンレッパーショー!
消えろ、僕の目の前から
闇の炎に抱かれて消えろ！
english: Vanish in the embrace of dark flames!

japanese: 貴様に見切れる数字もない
english: You can't hope to see through this!

japanese: 二度と会うこともないだろう
交わらざりし命に、今もたらされん刹那の奇跡
english: To lives never meant to cross, a fleeting miracle is now granted!

japanese: ここに融合せし未来への胎動
english: Fused here: the first stirrings of the future!

japanese: プリズムフラッシャー!

english: Not in a place like this!
I've got no time for small fry.

japanese: 先に攻撃させてから一気に叩くよ
english: Let them attack first, then we hit them all at once!

japanese: 古より伝わりし浄化の炎、喰らえ！
english: Purifying flame of ancient lore, devour them!

japanese: 氷結は終焉、せめて刹那にて砕けよ！
english: Ice is your end. Shatter in a single instant!

japanese: うぬぼれんじゃないよ！
手加減っての知らないもんでね
english: Sorry, I never learned how to hold back.
Well, that's about what I expected.

japanese: 戦う前に気づくんだったね
english: Should've figured that out before you picked a fight.
You just don't know when to quit.
Want me to fix you up?

japanese: これで勝ったと思うなよ！
english: Don't think you've won just yet!

japanese: 詠唱中くらい守んなさいよ
english: At least protect me while I'm casting!

japanese: プリズムフラッシャー!
聖なる意志よ、我に仇なす敵を討て！
english: O holy will, strike down the foes who stand against me!

japanese: 裁きの時来たれり、還れ、虚無の彼方
english: The hour of judgment has come. Return to the void beyond!

japanese: 古より伝わりし、浄化の炎、消えろ！
english: Purifying flame of ancient lore! Burn them away!

japanese: 氷結は終焉、せめて刹那にて砕けよ！
english: Ice is your end. Shatter in a single instant!
Take form, crystal of the spirits!

japanese: 失われし数多の意志よ、我が元へ来たれ！
english: O countless lost wills, come to me!

japanese: まばゆき無数の流星、我が心を映したまえ！
english: Dazzling countless meteors, reflect my heart!

japanese: 彗星の公費、かのものに粛清の慈悲を!
english: Grant that one the mercy of purging!

japanese: 我が旅に終結なし、されど煌めくは蒼き大地！
english: My journey has no end, yet the blue earth still shines!

japanese: トゥインクルスタート!
プリンセスオブマーメイド!
静かなる意志、粛清の力に変えて！
english: Turn this quiet will into the power to purge!
Hearts of justice, be with us!

japanese: 思考の意思を我らに誓ろう
浄化の光、彼らを救わん！

english: Mm! Got a little carried away!

japanese: いいデータ取れたってことで
english: Let's just say I got some good data.
A tough fight is fine too! ...Right?

japanese: ちょっと時間かかりすぎ
english: That took a bit too long.

japanese: 本気にさせたら怖いわよ
english: I'm scary when I get serious.

japanese: 成長してる感じがするし
english: I feel like I'm getting stronger.

japanese: 私に勝てると思ったの？
english: Did you really think you could beat me?

japanese: 見たか？　見てねーよ！　見てろよ！
english: Did you see that?|Didn't see a thing!|Then watch next time!

japanese: どうよ！女がほっとかないわけ、わかってくれた？　好きに言ってなさいよ
english: How's that? Now you see why the ladies can't resist me?|Say whatever you like.

japanese: どう、カイル、私の実力は
english: Well, Kyle? How's that for skill?

japanese: 足さえ引っ張られなきゃこんなもんさ　はぁ？
english: That's what happens when nobody's holding me back.|Excuse me?

japanese: おう、カイル！もうへばったか！　くそっ！
english: Hey, Kyle! Worn out already?|Damn it!

japanese: 誰か俺の毒治してくれてもいいだろ？　ああ、ごめんごめん
english: Couldn't someone cure my poison?|Oh, sorry, sorry.

japanese: 邪魔をするなと言っただろう
english: I told you not to get in my way.

japanese: ふぅ、ちょっと戦闘能力を計算し直した方がいいから回復!
english: Phew! Our fighting strength needs recalculating. Healing!

japanese: さっき見なかったか、こいつら
english: Didn't we just see these guys?

japanese: ほう、楽しませてくれそうだ

english: Leave the flying ones to me!
Aren't you hot? Why not take off the mask?

japanese: 寒いだろう、仮面取れば？
english: Aren't you cold? Why not take off the mask?

japanese: 行くぞカイル！ビビんなよ！
english: Let's go, Kyle! Don't chicken out!

japanese: 攻撃一辺倒で勝てると思うな
english: Don't think you can win just by attacking.

japanese: 自分のスピリッツに常に気を配れ！
english: Always keep an eye on your SP!

japanese: ガードを上手く使っていけ！
english: Make good use of your guard!

japanese: むやみに攻撃してもガードされるだけだ！
english: Attacking blindly will just get you blocked!

japanese: じゃあどうしろって言うんだよ
english: Then what am I supposed to do?!

japanese: よっしゃ！奴に先に攻撃させて、その直後を狙うんだ！
english: All right! Let it attack first, then strike right after!

japanese: 奴のスピリッツを減らしてからの攻撃だな
english: So we wear down its SP first, then attack.

japanese: 攻撃頻度を抑える作戦で行くぞ！
english: Let's attack less often and pick our moments!

japanese: こいつ、かなりガードが硬いな！
english: This one's guard is really tough!

japanese: 一度防御されると、ほとんどの攻撃が当たらねえ！
english: Once it starts guarding, hardly anything gets through!

japanese: ここは術を起点にして、そこから一気に畳みかけましょう
english: Let's open with Magic Artes, then press the attack all at once.

japanese: カイル！奴の動きを見逃すな！
english: Kyle! Don't miss a single move it makes!

japanese: ここまでガードが硬いのか
攻撃一辺倒で済むと思うな！
english: Don't think just attacking will cut it!

japanese: スピリッツが少ない時に攻撃するな！弾かれるぞ！
english: Don't attack when your SP is low! You'll get knocked back!

japanese: アイテム係ご苦労だったな　勝手に係に任命するな
english: Thanks for handling the items.|Who put me on item duty?!

japanese: まずいな、この魔法陣に入っちまうと毒になっちまうらしい
english: Not good. Step into this magic circle and you get poisoned.

japanese: そういうわけにもいかねえだろ　体力が少なくなったらすぐに下がれ
english: We can't exactly do that. If your HP gets low, fall back right away.

japanese: 魔法陣から離れれば毒は消える！
english: Get out of the magic circle and the poison wears off!

japanese: バルバトス！これ以上お前の好きにはさせない！
english: Barbatos! I won't let you have your way any longer!

japanese: 負けるか！俺は絶対に勝つ！
english: I won't lose! I'm going to win, no matter what!
You gave us a lot of trouble.

japanese: ダメージを与えると吐き出す泡が厄介だね
english: Those bubbles it spits when hit are a real pain.

japanese: ナナリー！なんとか撃ち落とせない？
english: Nanaly! Can't you shoot it down somehow?

japanese: できるだけやってみるよ

english: I'll back you up with Magic Artes too!

japanese: よし！もう一息だよ！頑張んな！
english: All right! Almost there! Keep at it!

japanese: 防衛機能が高そうだ！無闇に攻撃しないように注意しろ！
english: Its defenses look strong! Careful not to attack recklessly!

japanese: 知ってもどうしろって言うんだよ
english: Even if I knew, what am I supposed to do about it?

japanese: 遠距離からの攻撃だ。接近戦だけではこちらが不利になる
english: It attacks from range. If we only fight up close, we're at a disadvantage.

japanese: わかった！援護は任せた！
english: Got it! I'm counting on you for support!

japanese: 1、2発程度の攻撃では奴はグラつかない！とにかく連続して叩け！
english: One or two hits won't even make it flinch! Just keep hitting it!

japanese: おいおい、なんかやべえぞ、あいつ！
english: Whoa, whoa, something's wrong with that thing!

japanese: うわぁ、変態しやがった！
変身って言うんじゃないの？
そんなこと言ってる場合じゃないだろ
english: This is no time to be saying that!

japanese: あれは衝撃のみを拡散するバリアね
english: That barrier only disperses physical impacts.

japanese: スピリッツが低いうちは張れないみたいだけど
english: Looks like it can't raise it while its SP is low, though.

japanese: ダメージいってんなら気にせずどんどんかばせ!
ハッハッハッハッハッ
うんうんうんうんうん
貴様らはここで刀の錆となるのだ！
english: Here you will become rust on my blade!
I didn't think you'd get this far.

japanese: エルレイン様の理想は誰にも邪魔させぬ
english: No one will stand in the way of Lady Elrane's ideal.

japanese: 彼らをエルレイン様に近づけるな！
english: Keep them away from Lady Elrane!

japanese: 素直に忠告に従うべきでしたな
english: You should have heeded my warning.

japanese: 我が名のもとに敵を打ち砕け！
english: In my name, crush the enemy!

japanese: エルレイン様、我に力を！
無法なる者どもに正義の鉄槌を下す力を
english: Grant me the power to bring the hammer of justice down upon the lawless!

japanese: 予告通り、ジ・エンドだ
english: Just as I promised. The end.
To think this power could be broken...!

japanese: 我をここまで追い詰めた礼だ
english: This is my thanks for driving me this far!
A blow with everything I have!

japanese: 我が命に答えよ！そして滅ぼせ！
english: Answer my command! And destroy them!

japanese: はっはっはっはっはっ

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 一瞬で終わる。耐えぬ方が身のためだ
english: It'll be over in an instant. Better for you not to endure it.

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: さあ、見せてもらおうか。貴様らのもがきとやらを
english: Now, let's see this struggling of yours.

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: さあ、来いよ！貴様ら全員、みじん切りにしてやるぜ！
english: Come on! I'll cut every last one of you to ribbons!

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 今日の俺は紳士的だ。運が良かったな
english: I'm feeling gentlemanly today. Lucky you.

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: せっかく生かしておいたというのに、その程度か
english: I went to the trouble of letting you live, and this is all you have?

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 貴様らは、俺の最高の獲物だったぜ
english: You were the finest prey I ever hunted.

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: まだだ、まだ終わらんぞ！
english: Not yet! It's not over yet!

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 貴様らごときに、俺は、死なんぞ
english: I won't die... to the likes of you.

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 土下座してでも生き延びるのか？
english: Would you grovel just to stay alive?

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: ここだ！ここだ！ここだぁぁぁ！

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 灼熱のバーンストライク！

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 絶望のシリングフォール！

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 破滅のグランヴァニッシュ！

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 殺戮のイーヴィルスフィア！

speaker: Barbatos
japanese: 断罪のエクセキューション！
ハッハッハッハッハッ
神を超えるというのか
戦う前から分かっていたことだ
english: I knew it before we even fought.

japanese: プリズムフラッシャー
人は神には勝てないのだ
力の違いを見せてやろう
english: Let me show you the difference in our power.

japanese: インディグネイトジャッジメント
これ以上抗うというのなら
english: If you insist on resisting further...

japanese: せめて一瞬で葬り去るが慈悲
english: ...a swift end is the only mercy I can offer.

japanese: これでもまだ抗うのか
これで終わりと思ったか？
english: Did you think that was the end?

japanese: いでよ、虚空より来たれり数多の星屑
english: Come forth, countless stardust from the void!

japanese: 無限の流星、我が敵を滅せよ！
母なる海にて終焉を迎えよ
english: Meet your end in the mother sea.

japanese: すべては終わる。すでに一筋の希望もあらず
english: All things end. Not a single ray of hope remains.

japanese: 消える…消えると…言うのか
english: Vanish...? You mean I'm going to vanish...?!

japanese: 無益だということも無駄だということも、何故に理解しないのですか
english: Why can you not understand that this is futile, that it is pointless?

japanese: ディヴァインシーバー
力の違いを見せましょう
english: Allow me to show you the difference in our power.

japanese: 絶対的な差を思い知るがいい
english: Learn how absolute the gap between us is.

japanese: インディグネイトジャッジメント
これ以上は時間の無駄です
english: Anything more would be a waste of time.

japanese: これで終わりにしましょう

english: It is over. All of it.

japanese: 跡形もなく消えましたか
english: Gone without a trace, have they?

japanese: プリズムフラッシャー!
ライトニングハウンド
極限の雷、決着の時を与えよ！
english: Ultimate thunder, bring the moment of reckoning!
You think you won with that?

japanese: 何とか言ったらどうなんだ
ならばここから立ち去ればよいものを
english: Then you should have left this place.
I'll bury you in one blow.

japanese: 虚無の彼方に儚く散るか。さあ始めよう
english: Will you scatter into the void like dust? Now, let us begin.

japanese: なかなか興味深かったぞ
つまらん。意味のない時間を過ごした
english: Boring. A meaningless waste of time.

japanese: 主らの努力、全て水の泡とするも一興
english: Turning all your efforts to nothing could be amusing.

japanese: さあ、希望の光は一瞬のみだぞ
english: Now then. The light of hope lasts but an instant.

japanese: さあ、また繰り返すのか？
english: Well? Will you go through it all again?

japanese: 見せようか、我が力のかけら
english: Shall I show you a fragment of my power?

japanese: 全力を望むか。それは無理な相談だ
english: You want my full power? That is out of the question.

japanese: その程度で言える資格もないものな
english: At your level, you have no right to ask that.
